text: 人生在世，有许多的不如意，该面对的面对，该化解的化解，不要用一种苛刻的心态对待生活
en: Life in this world brings much that does not go as we wish; face what should be faced, resolve what should be resolved, and do not treat life with a harsh mindset.

text: 决定我们一生的 ，不是我们的能力，而是我们的选择
en: What determines our life is not our ability, but our choices.

text: 生活有进退，输什么也不能输心情，尝尽人生百味，方知人间冷暖
en: Life has its ups and downs; we may lose anything, but we must never lose our peace of mind. Only by tasting the full range of life's flavours do we come to know the warmth and cold of the world.

text: 我是37岁的中年男人。
en: I am a 37-year-old middle-aged man.

text: 现在找工作也不是那么好找。
en: Finding a job nowadays is not all that easy either.

text: 因为年龄大了。
en: Because I am getting on in years.

text: 一般工厂都要求18到35岁。
en: Generally, factories require workers to be between 18 and 35.

text: 超过了那个年龄。
en: Past that age.

text: 就需要找。
en: Then one needs to look for

text: 年龄大点的工作。
en: jobs for those a bit older.

text: 没有什么好工作。
en: There are no good jobs.

text: 我是等啊等，靠啊靠。
en: I waited and waited, relied and relied.

text: 半年过去了。
en: Half a year passed.

text: 一分钱也没挣到。
en: I did not earn a single penny.

text: 虽然没有房贷的压力。
en: Although there is no pressure of a mortgage,

text: 但是也有生活的压力。
en: there is still the pressure of daily living.

text: 这分明就是把人往死里逼啊！
en: This is plainly just driving people to the edge of death!

text: 有时候感觉生活有什么意义？
en: Sometimes I feel, what is the meaning of life?

text: 没啥体会
en: Not much to reflect on.

text: 能够沉下心来耐着性子去实现从前对未来的规划。
en: To be able to settle one's mind and exercise patience to realise the plans one once made for the future.

text: 入职后，小李马上被分配了五个微信号，作为业务员，他每天要完成的任务就是至少要添加30个好友聊天。
en: After joining the company, Xiao Li was immediately assigned five WeChat accounts. As a salesperson, his daily task was to add at least 30 friends to chat with each day.

text: 按照要求，添加的对象必须是40岁左右、具有一定经济基础的中年人。
en: According to the requirements, the people added had to be middle-aged, around 40, with a certain economic foundation.

text: 为了增加可信度，公司要求，他掌握的5个微信号必须使用真人头像。
en: To increase credibility, the company required that the five WeChat accounts he managed must use real-person avatars.

text: 孩子今年20多了，男孩，初中毕业学的汽修，刚刚修理入门不干了，现在在一个小工厂上班，挣的钱还不够自己花销，眼看就要说媳妇，买楼买车，还得给媳妇彩礼，愁死。
en: My child is over 20 this year, a boy, who studied car repair after finishing junior high; he had just got the hang of repairs but quit, and now works in a small factory, earning barely enough for his own expenses. With a wife to be discussed soon, a flat and car to buy, and bride price to pay his future wife, it is worrying to death.

text: 娘子四十出头，正是好美的时候，五一，七七，双十一是个节日就是买买买，自己挣自己花，还不错，够用了，知足。
en: My wife is just over forty, right at the age when she loves to look good. On May Day, the Double Seventh Festival and Singles' Day, every festival is just buy, buy, buy; she earns her own and spends her own, which is not bad, enough to get by, and she is content.

text: 我一个大车司机每月万八的工资，看着不少了，可我不抽烟，不喝酒，一分钱都不敢乱花，一个男人，顶天立地，养家糊口，天经地义，这个年头，虽说日子是越过越好，可谁又容易呀，什么是生活，父母把你生下来，你自己努力的活着，
en: I am a lorry driver earning around eighteen thousand a month, which looks like quite a lot, but I neither smoke nor drink and dare not spend a single penny carelessly. A man should stand tall and provide for his family — that is only right and proper. These days, although life gets better and better, who has it easy? What is life? Your parents bring you into this world, and you strive to live on your own,

text: 悲伤无用，气馁不行，人到中年，如果没有大富大贵，谁的生活都不易，我们不能活的最好，最起码可以活的好好的，加油吧，中年人。
en: Sadness is useless, and discouragement will not do. In middle age, if we are not rich and prosperous, no one's life is easy. We may not be able to live the very best, but at the very least we can live well. Keep going, middle-aged folk.

text: 每个人的经历不同，人生体会也不同，同为同龄人，如果你愿意分享，我们可以探讨一下
en: Everyone's experiences differ, and so do their reflections on life. As people of the same age, if you are willing to share, we can discuss it.

text: 前几天和理财陪伴营的小伙伴们聊到了十年后的梦想，有人说自己需要财务自由的钱数是300万，有人说自己达到财务自由的金额的是现金200万，资产1000万。
en: A few days ago, I chatted with the friends in the Wealth-Management Companion Camp about our dreams ten years on. Some said the amount of money they needed for financial freedom was 3 million, others said the figure for them to reach financial freedom was 2 million in cash and 10 million in assets.

text: 聊完梦想，大家就说好像300万的这个目标，跳一跳还是可以实现的，那么今天我就分享一下这个10年靠定投获取300万的财务目标吧。
en: After talking about dreams, everyone said that the 3-million target seemed achievable if one made a bit of an effort, so today I will share this financial goal of reaching 3 million through regular investing over 10 years.

text: 想要用定投实现这个目标，其实很简单，只需要3步走。
en: To achieve this goal through regular investing is actually very simple; it only takes three steps.

text: 一、确定自己财务自由需要的目标数
en: First, determine the target figure you need for financial freedom.

text: 这个我分享过很多次了，就是用你的家庭月开销乘以12乘以25，得出的数字就是你财务自由需要的金钱数。
en: I have shared this many times: take your household's monthly expenditure, multiply by 12 and then by 25, and the resulting number is the amount of money you need for financial freedom.

text: 我的目标就是每个月有1万元的被动收入就可以了，所以定的财务自由的目标也是300万。
en: My goal is simply to have 10,000 yuan of passive income each month, so the financial-freedom target I set is also 3 million.

text: 如果你发现自己家需要的钱数更多，那么现在得出这样的数字也不要慌张，毕竟你可以把时间从10年延长到20年，甚至是30年，一下子需要定投的钱数就会大大减少了。
en: If you find your household needs a larger sum, do not panic at this figure, for you can extend the time from 10 years to 20, even 30 years, and the amount you need to invest regularly each time will be greatly reduced.

text: 二、分解目标到每一周
en: Second, break the goal down week by week.

text: 我是在我还房贷的时候发现两周还一次房贷要比一个月还一次房贷更加有利，可以偿还更多的本金，大大地减少利息。
en: It was while I was repaying my mortgage that I found paying it every two weeks, rather than once a month, was more advantageous: it lets you repay more principal and greatly reduce the interest.

text: 于是就把这个方法分享给了理财陪伴营的小伙伴们，让他们把定投从每个月变成了每周定投，这样每年可以多强制性地存4周的本金，可以更好地实现自己的梦想。
en: So I shared this method with the friends in the Wealth-Management Companion Camp, getting them to switch their regular investing from monthly to weekly, so that each year they could compulsorily save four extra weeks of principal and better realise their dreams.

text: 比如原来每个月可以定投的金额是1000元，就分解到每周定投250元，一年就可以定投13000元的本金，等于多强制性地储蓄了。
en: For example, if the original monthly amount available for regular investing was 1,000 yuan, breaking it down to 250 yuan a week means 13,000 yuan of principal invested over a year — equivalent to extra compulsory saving.

text: 按照这个方法分解，想要10年达到300万的财务自由的目标的话，每周需要定投2500元。
en: Broken down by this method, reaching the 3-million financial-freedom goal in 10 years requires a weekly regular investment of 2,500 yuan.

text: 如果是20年达到300万的财务自由的目标的话，每周需要定投721元。
en: If it is to reach the 3-million financial-freedom goal in 20 years, a weekly regular investment of 721 yuan is needed.

text: 如果是30年达到300万的财务自由的目标的话，每周需要定投349.65元
en: If it is to reach the 3-million financial-freedom goal in 30 years, a weekly regular investment of 349.65 yuan is needed.

text: 我一直强调目标很重要就是这个原因，因为你完全可以通过你需要达到的目标，需要做到的时间，推算出自己每周需要定投的金额。
en: The reason I keep stressing that goals are important is just this: because you can work out the weekly amount you need to invest regularly entirely from the goal you need to reach and the time you have to do it in.

text: 也许在计算之前，会觉得这个目标很难实现。
en: Perhaps before doing the calculation, you would feel this goal is hard to achieve.

text: 但是当你看到每周只需要定投721元或者349.65元的时候，你就发现原来自己离目标这么近啊。
en: But when you see that only 721 yuan, or 349.65 yuan, needs to be invested regularly each week, you realise how close you actually are to your goal.

text: 三、选择适合自己的基金类型，坚定目标
en: Third, choose the type of fund that suits you and stay firm in your goal.

text: 对于30岁之前的小伙伴，我的建议就是用和生活无关的闲钱，比如工资的10%，20%以及兼职，奖金收入的50%全部都买入股票型基金，不建议买任何的债券，因为只要用的钱是正确的钱，留有6-12个月生活费的应急资金，也配置了意外险，百万医疗险，只是拿出收入的和生活无关的一部分钱来买基金的，就建议全部买入股票型基金。
en: For friends under 30, my advice is to use spare money unrelated to living costs — say 10% or 20% of your salary, plus 50% of any side-earning or bonus income — and put it all into equity funds; I do not recommend buying any bonds, because as long as the money used is the right kind of money, with an emergency fund of 6 to 12 months of living expenses set aside and accident insurance and million-yuan medical insurance in place, and you are only taking a portion of your income that has nothing to do with living costs to buy funds, then I would suggest putting it all into equity funds.

text: 当然市场有风险，入市需谨慎。
en: Of course the market carries risks; one must be cautious when entering it.

text: 但是如果做好了上面的所有安全的准备，用的又是和生活无关的闲钱，股票型基金是最适合想要40岁左右有一笔可以让自己财务安全，进而财务自由的30岁左右的朋友们的。
en: But if you have made all the safety preparations above and are using spare money unrelated to living costs, equity funds are most suited to friends of around 30 who want, by around 40, to have a sum that gives them financial security and, further, financial freedom.

text: 对于想要50岁实现这个目标的40岁的朋友建议宽基指数基金，股票型基金，混合型基金一起搭配，这样可以稳中有进。
en: For friends of 40 who want to achieve this goal by 50, I suggest combining broad-based index funds, equity funds and hybrid funds, so as to progress steadily with stability.

text: 对于想要60岁实现这个目标的50岁的朋友，建议宽基指数基金，混合基金，REITs基金，红利指数基金，债券基金一起，做到稳中有进。
en: For friends of 50 who want to achieve this goal by 60, I suggest combining broad-based index funds, hybrid funds, dividend index funds and bond funds, to progress steadily with stability.

text: 40多岁左右的中年人，是人生的成熟期，是责任担当最大。
en: Middle-aged people of around forty are at the mature stage of life, when their responsibility and burden are greatest.

text: 在工作单位是主干生产力，是家里的经济支柱，此时家中的小孩读初中或高中，又是青春期，叛逆期。
en: At work they are the mainstay of productivity and the financial pillar of the family; at this time their children are in junior or senior high school, and are going through puberty and a rebellious phase.

text: 家中父母需要孝顺。
en: Their parents at home need to be cared for with filial devotion.

text: 这么多方面都要面对，处理得好，是人生的大赢家，处理不好，就会力不从心，心累。
en: So many fronts must be faced; handle them well and you are a great winner in life, handle them poorly and you will feel powerless and mentally exhausted.
